Question: Assalamualaykum Q-A person who is fasting wheres a Nicotene patch on the arm is fast valid?(A nicotine patch is a transdermal patch that releases nicotine into the body through the skin. It is usually used as a method to quit smoking.) Answer ID: 7808 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1327/1061=L/1429) Yes, this will not affect the fast. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
